shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代整箱提装与单罐的组合关系。
一秒说清鲜摘果味主张，用冰镇冷凝与鲜果围绕放大口渴感。
用多格真实生活快照完成自我代入，让买家想象自己随手开罐的时刻。
让买家一眼看到可选口味谱系，按自己的偏好挑款下单。
用排版规整的空白成分板承接配料疑虑，数值全部留空由卖家自填。
用一张品牌人背书版式收口信任，引言位置留空由卖家填真实文案。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cream white #FFF7EE sweep for packshots, saturated apple-red #E23B2E gradient field for the flavour hero, soft lilac #CDBBEA studio field for line-up and endorsement frames, no dark or neon stages
style.direction: playful fruity zero-sugar canned sparkling energy commerce
style.iconSystem: flat single-weight line icons in deep green #1E5B33 inside blank pill rows, one empty serrated seal burst, no 3D badges, no star ratings
style.lightingSystem: bright warm-key studio light with soft even fill, one crisp specular streak on the aluminium shell, gentle short contact shadows, dewy condensation sparkle on the chilled can, never moody low-key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful fruity zero-sugar canned sparkling beverage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of apple red #E23B2E, lilac mist #CDBBEA, deep forest green #1E5B33 and cream white #FFF7EE; bright warm-key studio light with one crisp specular streak on the aluminium shell and dewy condensation sparkle on the chilled can; glossy cream sweep, matte lilac paper and pale laminate shelf blocks only, fresh apple garnish allowed, no cool ice-blue or neon black stages; one rounded serif display with calm geometric sans kept as empty placeholder slots; flat thin deep-green line icons and blank seal bursts; stable upright can angle and scale with a blank flavour band on the shell; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no redrawn label artwork, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no cool ice-blue or neon black stages
no redrawn label artwork or fruit illustration style shift
style.presentationRules: the can stands upright at identical silhouette scale in every frame, the lilac shell always carries a blank flavour band instead of label artwork, fruit garnish stays whole or cleanly halved, carton and tray show blank side panels only
style.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless cream sweep, matte lilac paper backdrop, pale apple-cream laminate shelf blocks, fresh apple skin and cut flesh as the only fruit garnish
style.typography: one rounded serif display paired with a calm geometric sans in deep forest green #1E5B33, every headline and quote slot kept as an empty placeholder
